text: Jise Dadi ne sab\nsaunpa... wahi RAAZ\nchhupa raha tha
Clue isi video\nmein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!
Chhat par sirf EK\nlohe ki seedhi
Us din ghar mein\nmarammat chal\nrahi thi
Shaam ko mistri\nseedhi bhi saath\nle gaya
SHANTI BAI\n"8 baje khaana\nbanakar chali gayi"
"9 baje dawaai ka\nparcel diya... Dadi\ntheek thi"
"Garmi bahut thi...\nraat bhar chhat\npar so raha tha"
Shivam ki nazar se\nkoi nahi bachta.
